page.overview:
Who is Neilikka?

Neilikka is a major character in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. One of the central figures of the game's fourth season, she debuts in the game's third season as an antagonist under the guise of Keeper Calice. Following orders from the Republic of Sherna, she was to monitor the Will of Oblivion, a mission that puts her in confrontation with both Fina and Roca, whom she hates for unknown reasons.

Neilikka is a young woman with short blonde hair and wears metal armor with mechanism attachments as her weapon when punching with her fists and a white skirt with long boots.

Her Hollow Keeper armor has a helmet and white coloring with green details and yellow claws.

"Neilikka" is Finnish for the flower of carnation.
